signatures.description: Build a meshlet LOD DAG runtime: clusters carry per-level geometric error bounds and a parent whose error is larger than its children, and the frame selector must pick an error-bounded cut with single-parent activation, hysteresis against cut thrash, and a hard per-frame triangle budget. Add cone-of-normals backface rejection plus bounding-sphere cluster culling that must be applied per cut node without desynchronising the watermark used to skip entire subtrees. Prove border-vertex consistency across neighbouring clusters at different LOD levels (no T-junctions, no cracks) and report exact triangle counts and culled-node ratios for a supplied mesh.
